scope: Contract/event identity, deterministic ingestion deduplication and an independent archival RPC reconciliation; no economic-order census or solver identity inference

verifiedFindings.finding: intent_hash identifies one signed payload, not one token_diff statement
verifiedFindings.mechanism: Engine calculates the signed payload hash once, then executes its Vec<Intent> statements in sequence with that same hash. Each TokenDiff statement emits an event carrying that hash.
verifiedFindings.consequence: Repeated intent_hash at distinct physical event locations is permitted by contract semantics. Removing all such statements is not deduplication and selectively withholds multi-statement execution.

verifiedFindings.finding: The old SQL excluded 25484 parsed statement appearances because their signed-payload hash repeated
verifiedFindings.basis: Saved prior 30-day aggregate results: 1003979 parsed account payloads minus978495 retained statements; audit counts must be reconciled by rerunning corrected queries before claiming corrected population totals.
verifiedFindings.status: Previously saved arithmetic; not a claim that all excluded appearances are legitimate until new physical-key/shape/version checks run.

verifiedFindings.finding: Public statement, signed payload, settlement receipt and economic swap are different grains

definition.economicSwap: No generally verified identifier in the observed contract logs. Multiple signed counterparties and token deltas can form one economic trade; receipts can batch several trades.

verifiedFindings.finding: Current on-chain source metadata attributes intents.near to the inspected commit
verifiedFindings.qualification: Metadata attribution is independently queried, but not a reproduced WASM/source equivalence proof.

verifiedFindings.consequence: Corrected queries retain only exact verified DIP4 token_diff0.4.3 and expose unsupported-version diagnostics. Other versions require a schema-specific audit.

verifiedFindings.finding: Official archival RPC independently matches four Dune token_diff events in a finalized successful receipt
validated: Four exact event objects at their log positions
Four signed payload hashes via independent Borsh+SHA256 implementation
Signed input signer and deltas match events

verifiedFindings.sampling: One purposive receipt; this checks decoding and identity semantics, not aggregate completeness or representativeness.

verifiedFindings.finding: The October27 confidentiality change makes public logs an incomplete current swap census
verifiedFindings.consequence: An observed fall in public signing accounts cannot by itself establish user attrition or less protocol-wide activity. The announcement date is not itself a causal estimate.

engineeringChanges.deduplication: Group exact raw business fields (block date/time/height,receipt,log index,status,event string); count distinct business versions by physical key; quarantine keys with multiple versions instead of selecting an arbitrary latest row. Keep data ordinals and all repeated signed-payload hashes.
engineeringChanges.numericValidation: Validate signed i128 decimal strings lexically against exact positive2^127-1 and negative2^127 magnitudes. Preserve39digitvalid values, reject zero and noncanonical strings. No currency amount approximation for statement identity/pair sign classification.
diagnostics: invalid_or_repeated_raw_key_rows (conflicting physical keys, not legitimate signed-payload multiplicity)
engineeringChanges.observationLimits: Dune documentation exposes physical position and update/ingestion timestamps but does not establish a uniqueness or CDC conflict-resolution guarantee. Corrected queries validate observed versions; they do not assume updated_at authoritatively resolves conflicts.
